text:
Maya Patel: Heads up — onboarding request for a new tenant org 'logistics-nimbus' in ap-east-6. Need GPU + networking ceilings before we hand off to infra ops.
Maya Patel: Account: 123456789012 (org-nimbus-prod). Goal date: 2026-04-02.
Maya Patel: Requested increases: p5 (8), p4d (2), g5 (24). ENI ceiling: bump from 50 -> 500 across the shard. SNAT entries per private subnet: need 64 -> 256. EIP pool: 10.
Maya Patel: Reason: ML training + low-latency serving for realtime routing models, bursty bootstraps for canaries. Will run mixed batching, need consistent AZ spread.
Samir Gupta: copying @Alice Chen for subnet/NAT concerns. Do we have spare AZ IP capacity in the two subnets we plan to use?
Alice Chen: quick check — the two candidate subnets (10.10.0.0/19 & 10.10.32.0/19) currently have ~420 usable IPs combined, but terraform reserves + node ENIs will eat ~120. If we get 24 g5 instances + 8 p5, ENI usage looks tight. Recommend /18 or request IPv4 pool increase from network team.
Rohan Singh: do we need to request dedicated SNAT NATGWs or can we rely on shared natgw? Shared has 1:many contention during bursts. For SLA we should request 2x natgw per AZ or allocate Elastic IP pool with failover.
Maya Patel: prefer dedicated NATGWs per AZ, plus EIP pool. Can infra ops advise on cost tradeoff? This tenant will be charged back but we want predictable egress.
Samir Gupta: cost note — rough monthly burn estimate for 8 p5 + 2 p4d + 24 g5 running moderate utilization: ~ $95k — will formalize. Also need service-linked role to create placement groups.
infra-bot: automated quota scan for account 123456789012: 
```
region: ap-east-6
current_limits:
  P5Instances: 0
  P4dInstances: 0
  G5Instances: 6
  ENIs: 50
  ElasticIPs: 2
  NatGateways: 1
```
infra-bot: flags: P5/P4d=not-entitled, G5 close to limit. Recommended: open AWS support case + internal entitlement request.
Alice Chen: we also need to preflight subnet changes with VPC team — expanding to /18 will affect route table shard and cross-account peering. I'll open a network preflight doc.
Maya Patel: created internal onboarding doc here: <https://redwood.internal/infra/onboard/logistics-nimbus>. Added expected traffic profiles and instance mapping.
Samir Gupta: ask: can someone file the AWS case? I'll draft the justification. Need exact quota numbers per AZ and a note about dedicated placement groups for p5.
Rohan Singh: tagging requirements: Please add resource tags: redwood:tenant=logistics-nimbus, cost-center=logistics, env=prod for the request. AWS sometimes uses tags to prioritize.
Maya Patel: added tags to the doc.
Samir Gupta: AWS case draft (put in thread): "Increase regional quotas in ap-east-6 for account 123456789012: P5Instances=8, P4dInstances=2, G5Instances=24; ENI=500; ElasticIPs=10; NatGateways=6. Justification: enterprise tenant onboarding; low-latency model serving with HA across AZs; required by 2026-04-02."
Alice Chen: also include subnet expansion request and SNAT pool increase in same ticket or separate? Prefer separate NAT/SNAT ticket to network team; AWS support can't expand our CIDR.
Samir Gupta: good call. I'll open two tickets: AWS quota case + internal network preflight + VPC change request.
Maya Patel: FYI — temporary workaround: we can spin up some g5p-lite instances in nearby region (ap-southeast-3) for training bursts if quota delays happen. But serving must be ap-east-6.
Rohan Singh: please also run the aws-cli check to capture current reported limits: `aws service-quotas get-service-quota --service-code ec2 --quota-code L-xxxx --region ap-east-6` — paste outputs to the case.
Samir Gupta: I'll queue the AWS case now and paste the case ID here.
Samir Gupta: Case created: 031122233344. Attaching justification + infra-bot scan + subnet plan.
Maya Patel: thanks — marking as blocker for tenant launch. Will follow up if we need interim capacity. :eyes:
